VL-LN Bench
	





VL-LN Bench is the first large-scale benchmark for Interactive Instance Goal Navigation (IIGN), where an embodied agent must locate a specific instance in a realistic 3D house while engaging in free-form natural language dialog. reputation: New benchmark in embodied multimodal navigation and dialog; gaining attention in the embodied AI and robotics research community.
